items.title: Pakistan's leadership stresses need for unity, reforms as nation celebrates Independence Day
items.description: Pakistan’s civilian and military leadership has stressed the need for unity and reforms as the nation celebrates 79 years of independence today. According to state-run Radio Pakistan , the day dawned with a 31-gun salute in Islamabad and a 21-gun salute at the provincial headquarters. A change of guards ceremony was also held at the mausoleum of Quaid-i-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah in Karachi. Flag hoisting ceremonies were also held at the Supreme Court and the Federal Constitutional Court in Islamabad. ‘Pakistan’s security linked to peace in our neighbourhood’ In his message, President Asif Ali Zardari paid tribute to Quaid-i-Azam, those behind the Pakistan Movement and those who sacrificed their homes, security and livelihoods in the struggle for a homeland. “But independence is not only a historic achievement. It is also a responsibility that each generation must carry forward. The Pakistan that was created through the democratic will of its people must continue to grow stronger, more secure and more prosperous. Our task is not only to remember what earlier generations achieved, but to add to it through our own work,” he said. The president said that the past year had reminded citizens of the strength of the Pakistani nation. Recalling last year’s brief military conflict with India, he said, “The events surrounding Marka-i-Haq demonstrated that Pakistan seeks peace, but also possesses the resolve and capacity to defend its sovereignty and national interests. The lesson of strength is ultimately a lesson of responsibility. A country that can defend itself must also use its strength to prevent conflict, protect peace and serve the interests of its people.” He said that the security and stability enjoyed today had come at a great cost, paying tribute to the martyrs of the armed forces, law enforcement agencies and police. “Their courage and commitment have helped safeguard our nation against external aggression and the threat of terrorism. The people of Pakistan remain deeply grateful for their service,” he said. He also highlighted Pakistan’s efforts to facilitate dialogue in the region. “Pakistan has effectively used its channels of communication, its geographical location and diplomatic capital to encourage dialogue and de-escalation at a time when wider conflict could have serious consequences for the region and the world,” he said. He reiterated that all disputes must be ultimately addressed through dialogue and diplomacy. “Our security is linked to the peace and stability of our neighbourhood and the world at large. Pakistan will continue to support efforts that reduce tensions, protect regional stability and create conditions for cooperation,” he said. The president also went on to say that the country must focus on the work that will determine Pakistan’s future. “We must strengthen our economy, create greater opportunities for our young people, improve education and skills, strengthen institutions through a series of governance, economic and social reforms to ensure that the benefits of development and democracy reach every part and community of the country,” he said. “Pakistan’s greatest strength is its young people. Across the country and around the world, they are demonstrating their talent in science, technology, business, education and the creative industries. Our responsibility is to give them the education, skills and opportunities they need to realise their potential. By investing in our youth today, we are investing in Pakistan’s future,” he added. “For ordinary Pakistanis, national progress is measured in practical terms. It means a young person finding the skills and opportunity to build a career. It means a family being able to access quality education and healthcare. It means farmers, workers, traders and businesses being able to plan for the future with greater confidence. The strength of Pakistan will ultimately be judged by whether our national progress improves the lives of its people,” President Zardari said. He also voiced Pakistan’s support for the people of occupied Kashmir, saying Pakistan will continue to support a peaceful resolution of the dispute in accordance with the aspirations of its people and the relevant United Nations resolutions. On Afghanistan, the president said that Pakistan had always respected and supported the national sovereignty of our neighbour Afghanistan and expected the same reciprocity. “It is sad that the current interim regime of Afghanistan is allowing and supporting a cocktail of terror groups to use their soil for launching attacks against neighbouring countries including Pakistan. It is sad the Taliban regime of Afghanistan is collaborating with India in launching terror attacks against Pakistani civilians and security personnel. They are doing this to distract us from the peace building efforts of Pakistan, recognised by the entire world,” he said. “I warn them to stop these evil actions against the people of Pakistan and assure all and sundry that the armed forces of Pakistan are capable of defeating these evil designs,” he said. He ended his message by calling on the nation to contribute to the country’s progress in whatever field they serve. ‘Pakistan committed to defending its national interests’ Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif also began his message by paying tribute to the founding leaders of Pakistan, saying the nation owed the fulfilment of its dream of an independent homeland to their vision, statesmanship and sacrifices. Highlighting the government’s economic achievements over the past two-and-a-half years, PM Shehbaz said the country had successfully navigated challenging circumstances to achieve economic stability and was now moving towards becoming a developed economy. He noted that remittances from overseas Pakistanis had increased by $11.3 billion over the past two years, which he termed a reflection of their confidence in government policies. The prime minister said harnessing modern information technology, promoting innovation-driven industrial and agricultural development, creating employment opportunities and establishing a world-class education and skills system remained among the government’s top priorities. Paying tribute to the armed forces, the prime minister said the military, under the leadership of Chief of Defence Forces (CDF) and Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, had demonstrated exemplary unity and courage during Marka-i-Haq, adding another chapter to the country’s history of defence. He said Pakistan remained committed to defending its national interests, including its right to water resources, and reiterated that the country would continue to play its role as a responsible nation and a stabilising force for regional and global peace. He cited the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye as testimony to the country’s growing strategic role in the region. The prime minister also expressed solidarity with the people of occupied Kashmir and the Palestinian people. He said lasting peace in South Asia was contingent upon a diplomatic resolution of the Kashmir dispute in line with United Nations resolutions, international law and the aspirations of the Kashmiri people. The prime minister also paid tribute to the martyrs of the armed forces and law enforcement agencies who sacrificed their lives for the country, and called upon all segments of society, particularly political parties, to work together for national unity, integrity and the advancement of national interests. He concluded his message by praying for Pakistan’s continued progress and dignity in the comity of nations. ‘Pakistan’s strength lies in the unity of its people’ CDF Munir, Chief of Naval Staff Admiral Naveed Ashraf and Chief of Air Staff Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmed Baber Sidhu also issued a message to mark Independence Day. According to Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), the armed forces paid tribute to the Quaid and those whose sacrifices resulted in a sovereign Pakistan. “Their vision, courage and resolve remain a guiding force for the nation and continue to inspire us to uphold the principles and ideals of Pakistan,” the statement said. “The armed forces of Pakistan respectfully acknowledge the supreme sacrifices of our martyrs, the services of our veterans, the dedication of law enforcement personnel and the contributions of every Pakistani who has served the nation. Their courage and selfless service have bolstered Pakistan’s resilience and safeguarded its independence, security and national interests,” it added. “As guardians of Pakistan’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, the armed forces reaffirm their unwavering resolve to defend the motherland against all threats, uphold the Constitution and discharge the sacred trust reposed in them by the people of Pakistan. United with the nation, the armed forces will remain steadfast in preserving peace and stability while creating an environment conducive to national progress and prosperity,” the statement said. “Pakistan’s strength lies in the unity and collective resolve of its people. On this Independence Day, let us renew our commitment to the enduring principles of faith, unity and discipline, strengthen national cohesion, promote tolerance and work together towards a secure, stable and prosperous Pakistan,” it concluded. Dar reaffirms determination to safeguard country’s sovereignty In his message on the occasion, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar recalled Marka-i-Haq and reaffirmed Pakistan’s determination to safeguard its sovereignty and territorial integrity. “We commemorated the first anniversary of Marka-i-Haq, recalling Pakistan’s resolute and successful response to Indian aggression in 2025,” he said in a televised address to the nation. “The occasion reaffirmed our determination to safeguard Pakistan’s sovereignty, security and territorial integrity while remaining firmly committed to international law, responsible state craft and the pursuit of regional peace.” At the outset of his address, the deputy PM extended greetings to Pakistanis and expatriates on the Independence Day, saying we commemorate the day “to pay tribute to Quaid-i-Azam whose visionary leadership, unwavering resolve and steadfast commitment transformed the aspirations for a separate homeland into reality”. He also paid honour to the leaders and workers of the Pakistan movement whose “courage, dedication and countless sacrifices laid the foundations of our independent state”. Dar said that since independence, the country had made “remarkable strides across diverse fields guided by the enduring principles of unity, faith and discipline”. “Today we are a resilient nation of more than 250 million people bound together by our shared history, collective heritage and common aspirations,” he added. He also noted that the country’s achievements in education, science and technology, economic development, sports, culture and other fields “reflect the talent, determination and immense potential of our people”. The deputy PM also mentioned Pakistan’s “strengthened” position on the international stage over the past eight decades. “Our expanding diplomatic engagement, growing economic connectivity and partnerships, and deepening defence and security cooperation reflect Pakistan’s confidence and its commitment to contributing to a peaceful, stable and prosperous region and world.” He also mentioned the defence accord signed by Pakistan, Turkiye and Saudi Arabia last week, saying the “historic agreement reflects our shared resolve to deepen strategic cooperation, strengthen collective security and addresses evolving regional and international peace and security challenges”. He also paid special tribute to armed forces, police and paramilitary forces of the country, saying their “courage, professionalism and unwavering commitment remain a bulwark of our national security”. Dar noted the country always “stood for peace, dialogue, cooperation and mutual respect among nations”. He referred to last year’s conflict with India and said the events “underscored the urgent need of peaceful resolution of longstanding disputes, particularly the Jammu and Kashmir dispute which remains a source of instability in our region”. “Pakistan will continue to extend its principles, moral, political and diplomatic support to the Kashmiri people in their just struggle for the realisation of their right to self-determination in accordance with the relevant UNSC resolutions,” he added. On the occasion, he urged people to “draw renewed inspirations from the ideals and vision that led to the creation of Pakistan”. “Let us reaffirm our collective resolve to strengthen our institutions, uphold our national unity, harness the potential of our people and build a stronger more prosperous and peaceful Pakistan for generations to come,” he concluded.

items.title: Stable cedi, falling inflation creating room for stronger credit growth – BoG Governor
items.description: Governor of the Bank of Ghana (BoG), Dr Johnson Asiama, says improving macroeconomic conditions, including relative exchange rate stability and declining inflation, are creating opportunities for stronger credit growth in the economy. He said the more stable currency, easing financial conditions and narrowing interest margins were providing a more favourable environment for businesses and financial institutions. Speaking at an engagement with chief executives of banks in Accra on Wednesday, August 12, Dr Asiama said the improvements were already beginning to translate into a rebound in credit creation. “Inflation has declined significantly, the exchange rate has remained relatively stable, financial conditions have eased considerably, and interest margins have become increasingly compressed. Against this backdrop, we are beginning to see a strong rebound in credit creation,” he said. The Governor, however, acknowledged that access to finance remained a major challenge for many small and medium-sized enterprises, particularly businesses operating within the agricultural value chain. He therefore urged banks to take advantage of the improved macroeconomic environment to expand lending to productive sectors of the economy. Dr Asiama also encouraged financial institutions to develop credit products that reflect the operating realities of businesses, especially those in agriculture, where income and cash flows are often seasonal. He said repayment structures tailored to borrowers’ cash-flow patterns could improve access to credit while helping banks manage lending risks more effectively. According to the Governor, the gains from improving macroeconomic conditions must ultimately translate into increased productive activity, business expansion and job creation.

items.title: Boxer Prichard Colón dies 11 years after suffering brain injury in fight
items.description: Former Puerto Rican boxer Prichard Colón has died at the age of 33, almost 11 years after suffering a severe brain injury during a professional fight that left him in a persistent vegetative state. Colón passed away on Thursday, according to an announcement made by his father and former coach, Richard Colón, in a Facebook post. “Good morning my people. I regret to inform you of the passing of my son Prichard from this earthly world, now he is in a better world. “I did everything possible to fulfil his wish, his dream of bringing him on vacation to Puerto Rico as much as he desired but couldn’t. “Thank you for so many years of love and prayers. As much as you can, please keep us in your prayers,” the father wrote. A former junior middleweight, Colón had built an unbeaten professional record of 16 wins, including 13 knockouts, and was widely viewed as one of the sport’s most promising young fighters before his career came to an abrupt end in October 2015. The devastating injury occurred during a bout against American boxer Terrel Williams at EagleBank Arena in Fairfax, Virginia. Colón sustained repeated blows to the back of the head, known in boxing as rabbit punches, and was knocked down twice in the ninth round before his corner halted the contest. He was immediately taken to hospital, where doctors diagnosed a subdural hematoma and performed emergency surgery. Colón spent 221 days in a coma and never regained the ability to walk or speak. He underwent years of rehabilitation and remained under the care of his family for the rest of his life. The incident prompted a significant safety reform in boxing. In 2016, the World Boxing Council introduced the “Prichard Colón Rule,” establishing zero tolerance for punches to the back of the head. In 2017, Colón’s parents filed a $50 million lawsuit against the ringside physician and promoters associated with the fight. Born on September 19, 1992, in Maitland, Florida, Colón also enjoyed success as an amateur, winning gold at the 2010 Pan American Youth Championship. His death has drawn renewed attention to the long-term consequences of head injuries in combat sports and the lasting impact of the reforms introduced in the wake of his injury. items.title: Tourism Minister orders removal of illegal structures around forts and castles
items.description: The Minister for Tourism, Culture and Creative Arts, Dzifa Gomashie, has called for the immediate removal of unauthorised structures around Ghana’s forts and castles, warning that continued encroachment threatens the preservation of the country’s cultural heritage. She said some heritage sites were facing severe pressure from illegal developments, including structures built within areas intended to serve as protective buffers around the historic monuments. Speaking at a symposium on the Korea-Ghana Heritage Project in Accra, Ms Gomashie said efforts to remove the structures must go hand in hand with sustained engagement with communities living around the heritage sites. According to her, residents are more likely to support preservation efforts when they understand the historical and cultural significance of the monuments. “Often, we leave out the engagement with the community. And so they don’t see the importance of why our, for example, call for the demolition of illegal structures around the forts and castles,” she said. The Minister said the extent of encroachment around some of the sites had become alarming and required urgent intervention. “If I show you pictures of the encroachment on the buffer for the forts and castles, you will join me in doing Aluta,” she said. Ms Gomashie stressed that protecting Ghana’s heritage sites could not be left to government alone. She called for stronger collaboration among traditional authorities, local communities, relevant state institutions and other stakeholders to prevent further encroachment and safeguard the country’s forts, castles and other heritage assets for future generations.

items.title: Five towers collapse as vandals attack 132kV transmission line
items.description: By Obas Esiedesa, Abuja Five transmission towers along the Ikot Abasi-Eket 132kV Double Circuit Transmission Line have collapsed following extensive vandalism of the facilities, the Transmission Company of Nigeria, TCN, has said. According to a statement issued by TCN on Friday in Abuja, the damage was discovered during a routine joint patrol of the transmission line by its linesmen on August 9, 2026. The company said a preliminary assessment showed that critical structural bracing members had been removed from Towers N9, N10, N11, N12, N13 and N15, resulting in the collapse of five towers. Further inspection revealed that structural members had also been removed and stolen from seven other towers along the transmission corridor. TCN said the affected towers had been structurally compromised, posing a risk of further collapse and raising concerns about the reliability of electricity supply along the corridor. To mitigate the impact on electricity supply, the company said the network had been reconfigured to prioritise power supply from Ibom Power. The transmission company added that its management was mobilising an urgent intervention to reconstruct the affected sections of the line and restore the integrity of the transmission infrastructure. It also said security agencies had been notified to support investigations into the vandalism and prevent further attacks along the transmission line route. TCN condemned the incident as an act of sabotage, stressing that it remained committed to maintaining a robust and reliable national electricity grid. The company urged stakeholders and communities along transmission corridors to support efforts to protect critical electricity infrastructure from vandalism and theft. items.title: Ganzourgou : Les jeunes de Méguet se mobilise autour de la Révolution progressiste populaire à la Journée internationale de la jeunesse
items.description: Burkina-Ganzourgou-Méguet-Jeunesse-Journée-Internationale-Célébration Ganzourgou : Les jeunes de Méguet se mobilise autour de la Révolution progressiste populaire à la Journée internationale de la jeunesse Méguet, 12 août 2026 (AIB) – La commune de Méguet, dans la province du Ganzourgou, a commémoré mercredi la Journée internationale de la jeunesse à travers une conférence sur la Révolution progressiste populaire (RPP), suivie d’une marche auprès du chef coutumier et d’une visite à la gendarmerie de Méguet. Animée par le chef du service promotion et insertion professionnelle des jeunes (S-PIPJ) de la mairie, le camarade Téwendé Gracias Minougou, la conférence a porté sur les fondements et les caractères progressiste et populaire de la RPP, ainsi que sur ses défis. Les échanges ont notamment porté sur la souveraineté nationale, le patriotisme, la participation populaire, la lutte contre l’impérialisme, le développement socioéconomique et l’autosuffisance alimentaire. La rencontre a réuni la présidente de la Délégation spéciale (PDS) de Méguet, Céline Bazemo, le secrétaire général de la mairie, Yacouba Ouattara, le Tingsoaba de Méguet, le premier vice-président de la Délégation spéciale, Justine Korsaga, ainsi que des membres de la veille citoyenne et des associations. Une forte représentation de jeunes et de femmes a également pris part aux échanges, aux côtés d’anciens militants des Comités de défense de la révolution (CDR). Prenant la parole, l’ancien militant des CDR, le camarade Kanazoé Boukaré, dit « Boukar CDR », a partagé son expérience de la Révolution démocratique populaire (RDP) conduite par Thomas Sankara. Il a évoqué les difficultés liées à tout processus de rupture et de changement, tout en disant garder espoir dans la dynamique actuelle. La PDS Céline Bazemo s’est réjouie de la mobilisation de la jeunesse et l’a invitée à mieux s’imprégner des idéaux de la RPP et à contribuer au développement de la commune. La marche a conduit les participants au palais du Naba Saaga de Méguet. Le chef coutumier les a exhortés à l’union et à l’entente et les a encouragés à accompagner la Révolution, avant de formuler des bénédictions. À la gendarmerie de Méguet, le commandant de brigade, Adama Milogo, a salué la démarche et rappelé que la gendarmerie est au service de la communauté. Il a partagé des observations recueillies après près d’un mois de service, que les jeunes ont promis de restituer à la population. Le Tingsoaba de Méguet s’est dit satisfait de la mobilisation et a exprimé sa reconnaissance au chef de l’État, le capitaine Ibrahim Traoré, pour la considération accordée à la chefferie coutumière et à la tradition. items.title: Osun Poll: APC unveils automated mobile campaign stage
items.description: By Henry Ojelu The All Progressives Congress, APC, on Thursday introduced a new dimension to political campaigning in Osun State with the deployment of an automated mobile stage for its mega rally in Osogbo, the state capital. The innovation, provided by campaign management firm Monan Innovation, became one of the talking points at the rally as a long trailer was transformed into a fully functional campaign stage for the APC’s final major campaign event ahead of Saturday’s governorship election. The technology-driven stage attracted the attention of party supporters and residents, demonstrating how innovation could transform conventional political campaign events. Rather than erecting a conventional stage at the rally ground, the automated mobile stage arrived as a trailer and was transformed into a complete platform for speeches and other campaign activities. The deployment reflects Monan Innovation’s growing focus on using technology to improve the planning, mobility, visibility and efficiency of political campaigns and events. The Osun rally also provided the firm an opportunity to demonstrate its event-management capacity before a large gathering of APC supporters and senior party leaders who attended the event to drum up support for the party’s governorship candidate, Bola Oyebamiji. The rally attracted Senate President Godswill Akpabio, governors, former governors, national and state party leaders, as well as thousands of supporters. The automated mobile stage formed part of the visual and technological infrastructure deployed for the event, reinforcing the APC’s attempt to present a modern campaign platform in the final hours of the electioneering period. Monan Innovation’s Osun assignment builds on its experience in political campaign management, particularly its work during the Ekiti governorship election. In Ekiti, the firm deployed campaign intelligence, voter research, field mobilisation, logistics and technology-driven communication as part of the campaign structure. One of its innovations in Ekiti was the deployment of mobile campaign stage trucks fitted with giant LED screens. The mobile units could be moved from one community to another and converted into functional campaign stages, allowing campaign activities to be conducted with greater mobility and flexibility. The company’s Chief Executive Officer, Mrs Moji Yakubu, said the firm’s approach was centred on understanding voters and deploying data and technology to make campaign decisions more effective. “Our approach is centred on understanding the mindset of the electorate and helping campaign teams make informed, data-driven decisions,” Yakubu said while discussing the firm’s Ekiti operation. The company is increasingly positioning itself at the intersection of political strategy, technology, campaign logistics, voter engagement and event production, as political parties in Nigeria seek more professional and innovative approaches to electioneering. The Osun mega rally provided another demonstration of that approach. By deploying an automated mobile stage that could be transported as a trailer and transformed into a campaign platform, Monan Innovation brought technology to the centre of the APC’s final major campaign event in Osun. The deployment not only enhanced the visual appeal of the rally but also demonstrated how technology could make political campaign infrastructure more mobile, adaptable and efficient. For Monan Innovation, the Osun assignment adds another high-profile event to its growing campaign portfolio while reinforcing its ambition to establish itself as a leading Nigerian campaign management firm. items.title: Education Committee probes financial, procurement practices in Colleges of Education
items.description: The Parliamentary Select Committee on Education has begun reviewing the financial and procurement practices of some Colleges of Education following adverse findings contained in the Auditor General’s reports for the 2024 and 2025 financial years. The exercise formed part of the Committee’s oversight duties, with management of the affected institutions appearing before lawmakers to respond to issues raised in the audit reports and outline steps being taken to address them. Chairman of the Committee, Peter Nortsu Kotoe, expressed concern about procurement lapses identified at some of the institutions and urged college authorities to strictly comply with the relevant procurement laws and procedures. He stressed the need for management to strengthen internal controls to ensure public funds were properly accounted for and used for their intended purposes. The Committee also raised concerns about the ability of the institutions to anticipate and manage risks that could affect their operations. A member of the Committee, Fred Kyei, urged the colleges to develop comprehensive risk management frameworks that would enable them to identify potential threats early and take appropriate measures to minimise their impact. Lawmakers further encouraged the institutions to prioritise regular in-service training for their staff, arguing that continuous professional development would help improve administrative practices and enhance the quality of services delivered by the colleges. Among the institutions engaged by the Committee were St John Bosco’s College of Education, Gambaga College of Education, Dambai College of Education, Al Faruq College of Education, OLA College of Education, Peki College of Education, St Francis College of Education and E.P. College of Education, Amedzofe. Others included Akrokeri College of Education, Wiawso College of Education, Nusrat Jahan Ahmadiyya College of Education, Sunyani Technical University and Dr Hilla Limann Technical University. The Committee said the engagements were intended to strengthen accountability and ensure that public educational institutions comply with prescribed financial, procurement and management standards.

items.title: Ganzourgou : La jeunesse appelée à prendre leur responsabilité dans la transformation du pays, la cohésion sociale et la défense du territoire
items.description: Burkina-Ganzourgou-Jeunesse-Journée-Internationale-Célébration Ganzourgou : La jeunesse appelée à prendre leur responsabilité dans la transformation du pays, la cohésion sociale et la défense du territoire Zorgho, 13 août 2026 (AIB)-La Direction provinciale des sports, de la jeunesse et de l’emploi du Ganzourgou a commémoré, le 12 août 2026 à Zorgho, la Journée internationale de la jeunesse, autour du thème : « Rôle, responsabilité et engagement de la jeunesse burkinabè dans la construction d’un espace confédéral souverain ». La haut-commissaire du Ganzourgou, Camarade Aminata Sorgho/Gouba, présidant l’activité, a livré le message de la ministre en charge de la Jeunesse. Le message rend hommage à la jeunesse burkinabè et rappelle sa participation aux différentes luttes ayant marqué l’histoire du pays. Le message appelle également les jeunes à prendre leur responsabilité dans la transformation du Burkina Faso, la cohésion sociale et la défense du territoire. Le ministre a notamment évoqué le Plan national de développement 2026-2030 et l’initiative Jeunesse Révolution en Marche (JeRM), lancée le 2 avril 2026. Le panel consacré à la vie révolutionnaire a permis à deux témoins de partager leur expérience de la RDP et leur lecture de la RPP. Ancien pionnier sous la RDP, le camarade Tilado Etienne Yameogo a expliqué que les deux périodes révolutionnaires se déroulent dans des contextes différents. Selon lui, la RPP intervient dans un contexte marqué par les attaques terroristes et la lutte pour la reconquête de l’intégrité du territoire. « Le révolutionnaire ne trahit pas, il est travailleur, il se lève tôt, se couche tard. La révolution se vit, elle ne se proclame pas », a-t-il déclaré. Il a aussi insisté sur la nécessité de placer le bien-être de la population au cœur de l’engagement. Ancien colonel-major à la retraite et survivant des officiers du Bataillon d’intervention aéroporté (BIA) de Koudougou, le camarade Salfo Kaboré a, pour sa part, rappelé certaines actions de la RDP, dont les trois luttes dans le domaine de la mobilisation populaire et de la protection de l’environnement ( lutte contre les feux de brousse, lutte contre la coupe abusive du bois, lutte contre la divagation des animaux), la bataille du rail et les actions des Comités de défense de la révolution (CDR). « La révolution, ce n’est pas de l’amusement. » a-t-il martelé. Pour lui, « Dieu aime le Burkina. » Mais il s’interroge si le Burkinabè s’aime ? « Dieu ne descendra pas du ciel pour nous sauver. Il faut s’engager dans la révolution », a-t-il indiqué. Il a invité les participants à l’unité et à l’éducation des enfants. La veille, le 11 août, une marche sportive d’environ 6 km aller-retour, du haut-commissariat à la place publique de l’Indépendance de Zorgho, avait été organisée. Elle a été suivie d’une séance d’aérobic. Au terme des activités, la haut-commissaire Aminata Sorgho/Gouba a remercié les populations, particulièrement les jeunes, pour leur mobilisation. Elle a également salué la participation des autorités coutumières et remercié les panelistes pour leurs interventions. Notons que les activités ont débuté par un match de gala opposant des acteurs ayant connu la Révolution démocratique et populaire (RDP) à des jeunes de la Révolution progressiste et populaire (RPP). La rencontre s’est soldée par un score nul de deux buts partout. Agence d’information du Burkina MS-DNK

items.title: Tannounyan : Une délégation gouvernementale salue l’engagement des appelés Immersion patriotique obligatoire à Banfora
items.description: Burkina-Tannounyan-Comoé-Banfora-Immersion-Visite-Délégation-Gouvernementale Tannounyan : Une délégation gouvernementale salue l’engagement des appelés Immersion patriotique obligatoire à Banfora Banfora, 11 août 2026, (AIB) — Une délégation gouvernementale conduite par la ministre de la Transition digitale, des Postes et des communications électroniques, Aminata Zerbo/Sabané, accompagnée du secrétaire général du Gouvernement, et du conseil des ministres, Ousmane Ouattara, a effectué, mardi, une visite sur les quatre sites abritant les appelés de l’immersion patriotique obligatoire dans la région des Tannounyan. Cette visite, intervenue après deux semaines d’immersion, avait pour objectif de s’enquérir des conditions d’apprentissage, de formation et d’encadrement des nouveaux bacheliers. À travers cette tournée, la délégation gouvernementale entendait également constater de visu les conditions dans lesquelles les jeunes appelés vivent cette expérience destinée à renforcer leur patriotisme et leur engagement citoyen. À l’issue de la visite, la ministre de la Transition digitale, des postes et des communications électroniques, cheffe de la délégation, a indiqué que cette mission répondait à une haute orientation du Président du Faso, le Capitaine Ibrahim Traoré, et du Premier ministre, Chef du Gouvernement. « Nous sommes venus constater les conditions dans lesquelles les nouveaux bacheliers effectuent leur immersion patriotique obligatoire. Nous avons visité les quatre sites qui abritent les appelés de la région des Tannounyan et nous avons constaté que toutes les dispositions sont prises pour leur permettre de réaliser cette immersion dans de bonnes conditions », a-t-elle déclaré. La délégation a notamment constaté la mise en place d’infrastructures et de services destinés au bien-être des appelés. L’infirmerie est fonctionnelle et dispose d’un personnel de santé présent sur les sites pour assurer la prise en charge des éventuels cas de maladie. La ministre a également salué l’engagement des encadreurs, dont le travail aurait déjà permis, en l’espace de deux semaines, d’obtenir des changements significatifs dans le comportement et l’attitude des jeunes. « Nous avons des encadreurs très motivés et très engagés qui, en deux semaines, ont réussi à opérer une transformation impressionnante au niveau des appelés », a-t-elle relevé. Selon la Cheffe de la délégation, les échanges avec les jeunes ont permis de mesurer leur adhésion à cette expérience. Elle a souligné que les appelés se disent fiers et heureux de participer à cette immersion, qu’ils considèrent comme une opportunité d’acquérir des valeurs utiles à leur épanouissement personnel, à leurs proches et à la Nation. Au nombre des enseignements retenus par les appelés figurent notamment le patriotisme, la solidarité, le courage, le don de soi, le sacrifice, le civisme, le respect d’autrui et la défense de la patrie. « Ce sont toutes ces valeurs qui vont faire d’eux les Burkinabè nouveaux que nous voulons pour la construction du Burkina Faso nouveau dont nous rêvons tous », a-t-elle expliqué. Mme Zerbo/Sabané a souligné qu’au-delà de l’apprentissage des valeurs civiques et patriotiques, l’immersion permet également aux jeunes de revisiter l’histoire du Burkina Faso, de mieux comprendre les grands défis auxquels le pays a été confronté et de découvrir les efforts consentis par nos devanciers pour les relever. Face aux défis actuels, la Ministre de la Transition digitale, des Postes et des Communications électroniques a exhorté les appelés à prendre pleinement conscience des enjeux auxquels le Burkina Faso est confronté et du rôle qui leur revient dans la construction du pays. Elle les a invités à faire de cette expérience une véritable école de responsabilité, de solidarité et d’engagement, afin de contribuer, à leur tour, au développement du Burkina Faso par les Burkinabè et pour les Burkinabè. Au terme de la visite, la délégation gouvernementale s’est déclarée satisfaite des conditions d’organisation de l’immersion dans la région des Tannounyan. La ministre a adressé ses félicitations aux appelés pour leur engagement, ainsi qu’aux encadreurs et aux agents de santé pour leur disponibilité. Elle a également salué le travail du Gouverneur de la région et de l’ensemble de son équipe pour la coordination des activités, sans oublier les femmes chargées de la restauration, dont la contribution permet d’assurer quotidiennement l’alimentation des appelés et des différents acteurs mobilisés sur les sites. Après deux semaines d’immersion, les appelés des Tannounyan poursuivent ainsi leur formation, entre apprentissages civiques, découverte de l’histoire nationale et acquisition de valeurs destinées à faire d’eux des citoyens davantage conscients de leurs responsabilités dans la construction du Burkina Faso. Agence d’information du Burkina JPY-DNK

items.title: Kogi, Edo CPs conduct joint patrol, rescue 9 kidnap victims
items.description: By Boluwaji Obahopo The Commissioners of Police in Kogi and Edo states, CP Naziru Bello Kankarofi and CP Patrick Daaor, have intensified security collaboration between the two states with a joint patrol at Aguda Village, along the Okene-Auchi Expressway, at the Kogi-Edo boundary. The exercise, conducted on Thursday, was aimed at assessing ongoing joint clearance operations and strengthening security around vulnerable routes and forest hideouts along the border corridor. The patrol was attended by the Chairman of Okene Local Government Area, Hon. Enesi Ahmed Nuhu, and other security stakeholders. The two commissioners inspected the deployment of personnel from the police and other security agencies involved in the seven-day joint clearance operation. They also moved into identified black spots and hideouts within the border forest to assess the security situation and the readiness of personnel deployed to the area. The Police Public Relations Officer, ASP Afusat Salihu, in a statement issued on Friday in Lokoja, said the assessment would further enhance operational planning, intelligence sharing and coordinated responses to security threats along the corridor. She said the joint operation had already yielded a major breakthrough with the rescue of nine kidnap victims abducted along the Mameramo-Adomu Road on August 11. According to her, the victims were rescued through an intelligence-led operation involving the Nigeria Police Force, Nigerian Army, Nigerian Navy Ship Lugard, Department of State Services, Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps, local vigilantes and other auxiliary security forces from Kogi and Edo states. She added that the victims were safely evacuated, debriefed and reunited with their families. The commissioners also engaged members of the border communities during the exercise, with residents raising security concerns affecting the area and road users. The concerns were noted, while the police assured the communities that appropriate security measures would continue to be implemented to address identified threats. The statement said the joint patrol reaffirmed the commitment of the Kogi and Edo commands to sustained collaboration, timely intelligence sharing and coordinated operations to deny criminals access to safe havens and prevent them from exploiting the boundary between the two states. It added that the initiative would enhance the safety of residents, travellers and other road users along the strategic Okene-Auchi corridor. items.title: Présidence du Roscao : le Sénégalais Papa Thierno Homère Seck candidat !
items.description: Le Sénégalais Papa Thierno Homère Seck est candidat à la présidence du Réseau des organisations de la société civile de l’Afrique de l’Ouest (Roscao), dont l’élection est prévue le 22 août prochain, a-t-on appris de source proche de sa campagne. La campagne électorale pour ce scrutin régional, ouvert aux organisations de la société civile de l’espace communautaire, a démarré lundi 10 août. Le candidat sénégalais est en compétition avec le président sortant du Roscao, le Béninois Coovi Paul Adahou. Créé en 2003 et basé au Bénin, le Roscao œuvre au renforcement de la participation de la société civile aux processus de développement, de gouvernance et de défense des droits. Il intervient également dans la promotion de la paix, de la bonne gouvernance et de la protection de l’environnement. Membre du réseau depuis trois ans et coordonnateur du Roscao au Sénégal depuis mars 2024, Papa Thierno Homère Seck met en avant son expérience dans les activités de médiation, d’observation électorale et de dialogue sous-régional. Il a notamment participé à la médiation dans le différend entre le Niger et le Bénin et pris part à des missions d’observation des élections locales et législatives de janvier 2026 ainsi que de la présidentielle béninoise d’avril 2026. Dans son projet de gouvernance, le candidat sénégalais entend faire du Roscao « un réseau fort, uni et innovant pour une Afrique de l’Ouest démocratique et prospère ». Il propose notamment de professionnaliser l’observation électorale à travers des formations certifiantes, de digitaliser le suivi des scrutins et de renforcer les actions de sensibilisation citoyenne. Son programme prévoit également la mise en place d’un baromètre régional de la transparence, une cellule d’alerte et d’assistance juridique pour les acteurs de la société civile, ainsi que des initiatives en faveur de la transition écologique et du développement durable. Papa Thierno Homère Seck ambitionne, en outre, de renforcer l’autonomie financière du réseau, d’améliorer la coordination entre les représentations nationales et d’accroître la participation des jeunes et des femmes dans les instances décisionnelles. Le scrutin du 22 août comportera deux volets. Les personnes physiques ressortissantes des pays membres de la Cedeao peuvent participer au vote préalable, tandis que les associations et ONG établies dans l’espace communautaire constituent les grands électeurs appelés à voter le jour du scrutin. Selon le communiqué, les suffrages recueillis lors du vote préalable des personnes physiques seront pris en compte dans le résultat final de l’élection présidentielle du Roscao.

items.title: World Cup, Super Eagles’, AFCON heartbreak dominate google searches
items.description: By Juliet Umeh The FIFA World Cup, the Super Eagles’ Africa Cup of Nations, AFCON, heartbreak, the Blord-VDM saga and the mysterious “67” Gen Z meme were among the stories that drove Nigerians to Google in the first seven months of 2026. Fresh Google Trends data covering January to July showed that Nigerians used the search engine to follow major sporting events, geopolitical tensions, celebrity controversies, deaths, internet culture and developments affecting their daily lives. “Every big story now has a second life in the search bar,” Google said in its review of the trends. “When the Super Eagles lost a semi-final on penalties, when a strait most people had never thought about pushed up the price of petrol, when a music promoter’s car crash reopened a three-year-old argument, Nigerians went to Google.” According to the data, the FIFA World Cup emerged as the biggest search story of the period, generating significantly more interest than other major topics. Nigerians followed the tournament closely, searching for information on the Super Eagles’ campaign, the opening ceremony featuring Burna Boy and Shakira, major matches and the eventual final. “The World Cup over everything,” Google said, noting that “no story came close.” The AFCON also dominated searches in January, particularly following Nigeria’s semi-final defeat to Morocco on penalties. “January belonged to AFCON, and to heartbreak,” Google said, adding that “Nigeria vs Morocco” became one of the biggest individual queries of 2026. The search data, according to Google, reflected “a country going through the full arc: fixtures, hope, heartbreak, and ‘AFCON final’ anyway.” February produced another surprise, as the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics attracted significant search interest among Nigerians, including searches around ice hockey and other winter sports. “Nigeria watched a Winter Olympics,” Google said, adding: “Curiosity, it turns out, does not need snow.” Beyond sports, developments involving Iran and the Strait of Hormuz also generated significant search interest, highlighting how international events could quickly become local concerns. Queries such as “Iran news,” “Israel Iran war” and “Strait of Hormuz meaning” spiked as tensions around the strategic waterway raised concerns about global oil supplies and prices. “Geopolitics rarely trends in the abstract,” Google said. It explained that as tensions around the Strait of Hormuz intensified, Nigerians searched not only for updates on the international developments but also for their possible implications. “A war three thousand miles away was also a story about the cost of the ride to work,” Google said. The controversy involving cryptocurrency entrepreneur Blord and social media activist VeryDarkMan was another major search driver. The “Blord and VDM saga” sustained search interest for months, peaking around Blord’s arrest and subsequent release on bail. “‘Who is Blord’ ran alongside the main queries,” Google noted, describing the searches as “signs of new arrivals catching up on a drama already in its third act.” Internet culture also captured Nigerians’ attention, with the mysterious “67” meme emerging as one of the notable searches of the year. “‘67’, the Gen Z meme, peaked in January, baffling every Nigerian over 25,” Google said. Explaining the phenomenon, the company described it as a phrase lifted from a US rap song and used by teenagers, often accompanied by a hand gesture, with little or no specific meaning. The search trends also reflected moments of loss, with the deaths of personalities including singer Destiny Boy, actor Alexx Ekubo and American actor Eric Dane generating significant interest. “Three deaths cut through everything else,” Google said. It noted that searches around Destiny Boy’s death in January, as well as the homicide investigation and autopsy that followed, kept his name in the headlines for weeks. Google also said searches around Alexx Ekubo surged again in June as he was laid to rest in Arochukwu, while the death of American actor Eric Dane also generated significant interest. Accountability, politics and legal battles featured prominently among the issues Nigerians searched for during the period. “Accountability stories drew steady traffic all period,” Google said, highlighting searches around former Minister of Power Saleh Mamman, the Lagos State House of Assembly speakership saga involving Mudashiru Obasa and the release of documents connected to Jeffrey Epstein in the United States. Celebrity controversies provided another major source of search traffic. The divorce controversy involving veteran broadcaster Frank Edoho and his former wife generated significant interest, while a road crash involving music promoter Sam Larry revived public conversations around the late singer Mohbad. “Celebrity headlines that would not sit still,” Google said, describing the continuing interest generated by some of the personalities and controversies. Entertainment remained a major part of Nigeria’s search culture, with Nigerians following music, films and global entertainment events. Wizkid and Asake’s “Jogodo”, the 2026 Grammy Awards, Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl halftime performance, Mortal Kombat 2 and Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey were among the entertainment-related searches that attracted significant attention. Communications and Public Affairs Manager, West Africa, Google, Mr Taiwo Kola-Ogunlade, said the trends offered insight into what Nigerians were paying attention to during the period. “Search data is the most honest record of national attention we have, because nobody performs for a search bar,” Kola-Ogunlade said. “Nigerians did not just watch these stories, they interrogated them: the shootout, the strait, the files, the meme.” He added: “Seven months of data says the same thing every month. When something matters in this country, it trends on Search before it reaches the front page.” Google said the rankings were based on each story’s peak monthly search interest in Nigeria between January and July 2026, with related queries grouped together. Other trending searches during the period included the 2026 Grammy Awards, the Epstein files, hantavirus and Saleh Mamman, among others. The post World Cup, Super Eagles’, AFCON heartbreak dominate google searches appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Balé : Le vice-président de la délégation spéciale lance les travaux de la commission ad’hoc pour l’apurement du passif foncier dans la commune de Poura
items.description: Burkina/Balé-Commission-Apurement-Foncier Balé : Le vice-président de la délégation spéciale lance les travaux de la commission ad'hoc pour l'apurement du passif foncier dans la commune de Poura Poura, 12 août 2026 (AIB)- Le premier vice-président de la délégation spéciale, le camarade Néa Ouambi, a procédé au lancement des travaux de la commission ad'hoc pour l'apurement du passif foncier dans la commune, le mardi 11 août 2026. La commune de Poura fait face à un ensemble de situations foncières non résolues qui entravent la planification urbaine, la sécurisation des droits fonciers et la mise en œuvre des projets de développement. Ces situations incluent des occupations irrégulières, des conflits de propriété, des titres non régularisés, des parcellisations inachevées et des litiges communautaires entraînant des difficultés pour le paiement de la taxe de jouissance au niveau des recettes communales. Afin de résorber cette situation et parer ces difficultés qui pénalisent les usagers, la mairie de Poura a mis en place une commission ad'hoc, le 15 avril 2026, pour l'apurement du passif foncier. Cette commission est composée de 15 membres et les travaux sont prévus pour 20 jours. Elle aura pour mission de faire une revue documentaire relative aux opérations de lotissement de la ville de Poura ; d'identifier les parcelles attribuées et non attribuées mais illégalement occupées ; ainsi que les réserves illégalement occupées ou non. À l'issue des 20 jours de travaux, la commission devra déposer un rapport à soumettre à la délégation spéciale, un projet du nouveau plan de lotissement et la liste des demandes traitées. Pour mener à bien cette activité, des techniciens du domaine sont venus en appuis de Dédougou. Il s'agit du géomètre Ouedraogo Issouf en service à la direction régionale de l'urbanisme de Bankui et du contrôleur des impôts, Séverin Ilboudo de la direction régionale des impôts de Dédougou. On peut noter également la participation du directeur du centre départemental des impôts de Fara, le camarade Yacouba Soma. Agence d'information du Burkina MS-DNK

items.title: Nayef Aguerd renonce à la Real Sociedad après sa visite médicale
items.description: Alors que son départ semblait totalement bouclé, Nayef Aguerd ne rejoindra finalement pas la Real Sociedad. Le défenseur marocain, qui avait pourtant passé avec succès sa visite médicale et alors qu’un accord avait été trouvé entre les deux clubs, a décidé de décliner la proposition espagnole après un échange avec l’entraîneur Pellegrino Matarazzo. Selon les informations de Foot Mercato, le défenseur marocain a finalement décidé de renoncer au projet espagnol, malgré une visite médicale réussie et un accord déjà trouvé entre l’OM et la Real Sociedad. Les deux clubs s’étaient entendus sur les modalités de l’opération. Aguerd devait rejoindre la Real Sociedad dans le cadre d’un prêt payant de 3 millions d’euros, assorti d’une option d’achat non obligatoire de 17 millions d’euros. Le dossier paraissait d’autant plus logique que l’international marocain connaît déjà parfaitement le club basque. Il y avait évolué lors de la saison 2024-2025 et devait donc retrouver un environnement qu’il connaissait déjà. Mais alors que tout semblait réuni pour officialiser son retour à Saint-Sébastien, la situation a complètement changé. Le principal élément de ce retournement serait un échange entre Nayef Aguerd et Pellegrino Matarazzo, l’entraîneur de la Real Sociedad. Après cette discussion, le défenseur marocain aurait finalement décidé de décliner la proposition du club espagnol. Une décision particulièrement surprenante puisque le joueur avait déjà effectué sa visite médicale avec succès. Le dossier était donc extrêmement avancé et les deux clubs avaient déjà trouvé un terrain d’entente. Pour Aguerd, l’avenir reste donc totalement ouvert. Après avoir refusé de rejoindre la Real Sociedad malgré un accord et une visite médicale réussie, le Marocain va désormais étudier d’autres possibilités pour poursuivre sa carrière. The post Nayef Aguerd renonce à la Real Sociedad après sa visite médicale appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: Balochistan home minister unhurt as convoy comes under attack in Mastung
items.description: QUETTA: Six people, including three police personnel, were injured in an armed attack on the convoy of Balochistan Home Minister Mir Ziaullah Langove in Mastung on Friday. A senior police official told Dawn that the home minister remained unhurt in the attack, which occurred as his convoy reached the Khad Kocha area of Mastung. He said that Langove was on his way to Quetta from Kalat. The official added that six people sustained bullet injuries in the attack, three of whom were police personnel. Nawab Raisani Memorial Hospital’s Dr Sana also confirmed to Dawn that six injured had been brought to the hospital and two of them were in serious condition. She said two of the others were referred to Quetta. Security forces have cordoned off the area and launched a search operation. Langove, who is from the Balochistan Awami Party, was sworn in as provincial home minister in March. Langove had also served as the provincial home minister previously, but his appointment was declared null and void after he was de-notified on August 21, 2024.

items.title: Immersion patriotique des professionnels des médias : Les ministres de la sécurité et de la communication échangent avec les journalistes
items.description: Ce jeudi 13 août 2026, les camarades ministres de la Sécurité, le Commissaire divisionnaire de police Mahamadou SANA, et de la Communication, de la Culture, des Arts et du Tourisme, PENGWENDE Gilbert OUEDRAOGO, se sont rendus à l’Académie de Police, sise à Pabré, pour toucher du doigt l’effectivité de l’immersion patriotique obligatoire des professionnels des médias au titre de l’année 2026. Cette immersion concerne 44 journalistes issus de 44 organes de presse, publics comme privés, avec une attention particulière accordée aux médias régionaux, afin de favoriser une meilleure compréhension des réalités du terrain et des enjeux liés au traitement de l’information dans le contexte actuel. « On ne peut pas parler de révolution, on ne peut pas parler de changement de mentalité, on ne peut pas parler d’éveil de conscience en révolution sans prendre en compte les hommes et les femmes des médias. Alors, mon collègue et moi, nous sommes venus constater l’effectivité de cette immersion patriotique obligatoire 2026 des journalistes », a déclaré le camarade ministre de la Sécurité, Mahamadou SANA, devant les immergés. Pour sa part, le camarade ministre en charge de la Communication, PENGWENDE Gilbert OUEDRAOGO, a souligné la pertinence du choix porté sur les professionnels des médias dans le contexte actuel. « Dans un pays engagé dans la lutte contre le terrorisme et dans la reconquête de sa souveraineté, le journaliste ne peut être considéré comme un citoyen quelconque », a-t-il soutenu. S’adressant aux immergés, il les a invités à faire du patriotisme, du professionnalisme et de l’engagement les trois valeurs cardinales de leur métier. « Pour un journaliste, le patriotisme devrait être une évidence. Le patriotisme n’est pas une option », a-t-il martelé, appelant les immergés et l’ensemble des professionnels des médias à faire preuve d’un engagement accru dans le contexte de la Révolution progressiste populaire. Au cours de cette immersion, les appelés ont également bénéficié de conférences thématiques destinées à renforcer leurs connaissances et leurs capacités professionnelles. Une communication sur le journalisme de guerre a été animée par Liradan Philippe Ada, tandis qu’une autre, consacrée à l’éthique et à la déontologie du journaliste, a été présentée par Arsène Evariste KABORÉ. Le camarade ministre de la Sécurité a, par ailleurs, annoncé la pérennisation de l’immersion patriotique obligatoire des professionnels des médias, qui sera désormais organisée chaque année. Cette initiative vise à accompagner le ministère de la Communication dans le renforcement des capacités des professionnels des médias et à leur permettre de mieux appréhender et traiter l’information dans un contexte de crise. items.title: Etude : Comment Facebook et TikTok ont amplifié la vague de passages vers Sebta
items.description: Les images qui ont marqué la frontière entre le Maroc et l’enclave espagnole de Sebta à la fin du mois de juillet continuent d’alimenter les débats. Alors que des milliers de personnes ont tenté de rejoindre la ville espagnole, une récente analyse de la chercheuse marocaine Myriam Cherti, du Centre sur la migration, les politiques et la société (COMPAS) de l’Université d’Oxford, avance une lecture nuancée du phénomène : ni totalement spontané, ni entièrement orchestré. Dans une tribune publiée par Bloomberg , la spécialiste des migrations estime que l’ampleur inédite des événements ne peut être comprise à travers le seul prisme d’une organisation centralisée. Selon elle, les réseaux sociaux et les mécanismes algorithmiques qui les sous-tendent ont joué un rôle déterminant dans la transformation d’un ensemble de décisions individuelles en une dynamique collective de grande ampleur. Pour étayer son analyse, Myriam Cherti s’appuie notamment sur une étude consacrée à une précédente mobilisation migratoire vers Sebta, en septembre 2024. Cette recherche avait examiné 180 publications à forte audience diffusées sur Facebook, TikTok, X et Reddit. Plus de 80 % de ces contenus étaient rédigés en darija marocaine, signe que les échanges se développaient avant tout dans un cadre local. L’étude montre que Facebook et TikTok constituaient alors les principaux espaces de diffusion des contenus encourageant ou documentant les tentatives de passage, tandis que X et Reddit servaient davantage de plateformes de discussion et de commentaire. Les publications analysées mêlaient récits de traversées réussies, avertissements concernant les risques de noyade, informations sur les mouvements des forces de sécurité et échanges autour des procédures migratoires espagnoles. Elles traduisaient également un profond malaise lié aux conditions sociales et économiques. Si aucun élément ne permet, selon la chercheuse, de parler d’une campagne centralisée de propagande, plusieurs caractéristiques rappellent néanmoins le fonctionnement de campagnes numériques coordonnées. La circulation d’une date précise, la diffusion de comptes à rebours, de slogans ou encore d’images récurrentes ont contribué à créer un sentiment d’appartenance collective parmi les participants potentiels. L’activité en ligne avait alors culminé le 15 septembre 2024. Aux yeux de Myriam Cherti, les événements de l’été 2026 semblent avoir reproduit une dynamique similaire. Dès les premiers jours de la crise, des messages affirmant à tort que les frontières étaient ouvertes ont circulé massivement sur les réseaux sociaux. D’autres publications ont relayé des interprétations exagérées d’une récente décision de la Cour suprême espagnole relative aux garanties procédurales accordées aux migrants arrivant par voie maritime. Le Premier ministre espagnol, Pedro Sánchez, a lui-même accusé les réseaux de trafic de migrants d’avoir exploité cette décision en diffusant des informations trompeuses. Dans ce contexte, les images montrant des personnes parvenues à rejoindre Sebta ont joué un rôle d’accélérateur. Chaque traversée réussie et largement partagée en ligne a renforcé l’idée que l’objectif était accessible, alimentant ainsi un effet d’entraînement auprès d’autres candidats au départ. L’analyse relève également qu’au cours des premières heures de la crise, certains observateurs ont eu l’impression que les forces marocaines chargées de la surveillance frontalière avaient réduit leur niveau d’intervention ou interrompu temporairement certaines interceptions. Cette perception a nourri les spéculations sur une éventuelle instrumentalisation politique de la migration. La chercheuse se montre toutefois prudente. Elle souligne qu’aucune preuve ne permet d’établir une implication délibérée de l’État dans l’organisation des mouvements observés. Les interrogations liées au déploiement ou au degré d’intervention des forces de sécurité ne sauraient, à elles seules, démontrer l’existence d’une décision officielle visant à favoriser la vague migratoire. Au fil de la crise, le récit dominant sur les réseaux sociaux a d’ailleurs évolué. Les vidéos célébrant les arrivées ont progressivement laissé place à des témoignages plus sombres. Plusieurs migrants présents à Sebta ont commencé à décrire les difficultés rencontrées sur place, tandis que les appels à retrouver des personnes disparues se multipliaient. Le discours est ainsi passé de la promesse d’une opportunité à l’évocation des risques et des pertes humaines. Pour Myriam Cherti, les plateformes numériques n’ont pas créé le désir de migration. Elles ont surtout servi de caisse de résonance à des frustrations déjà ancrées dans la société. La chercheuse rappelle à cet égard les données du Haut-Commissariat au Plan selon lesquelles près d’un jeune sur trois âgé de 15 à 29 ans se trouve hors de l’emploi, de l’éducation et de la formation. Les témoignages recueillis auprès de participants à la vague de départs évoquent des salaires jugés insuffisants, le manque d’opportunités professionnelles, le poids des responsabilités familiales et la conviction qu’un avenir meilleur est possible en Espagne. Dans les discussions en ligne, la décision de partir était fréquemment associée à des notions telles que la « dignité » ou la « hogra », transformant parfois l’acte migratoire en expression d’un sentiment d’exclusion sociale. Pas de « cerveau » identifié derrière les traversées L’analyse rejette également l’idée d’un acteur unique pilotant les événements. Si l’existence de passeurs et d’intermédiaires profitant de la migration irrégulière n’est pas contestée, aucune preuve publique solide ne permet, selon la chercheuse, de désigner un réseau, une organisation politique ou une institution officielle comme instigateur principal de la vague de passages. Cette conclusion est notamment renforcée par le profil des participants. Nombre d’entre eux se sont rendus dans la région par leurs propres moyens avant de tenter la traversée à la nage, loin du modèle classique des filières structurées reposant sur des embarcations et une logistique organisée. L’étude met également en lumière le rôle joué par les algorithmes des plateformes. Dans l’échantillon analysé pour l’année 2024, les vidéos de « réussite » diffusées sur TikTok ont enregistré un nombre de vues 4,6 fois supérieur à celui des contenus de mise en garde. Sur Facebook, les publications encourageant les traversées ont cumulé plus de 50 millions de vues. Selon Myriam Cherti, Facebook et TikTok n’ont pas organisé les départs au sens traditionnel du terme. En revanche, leurs systèmes de recommandation ont largement contribué à amplifier certains récits plutôt que d’autres. Les contenus valorisant la réussite migratoire et les perspectives d’avenir ont bénéficié d’une visibilité nettement supérieure à celle des messages alertant sur les risques de noyade ou sur les difficultés rencontrées à Sebta. Face à ce constat, la chercheuse estime qu’une réponse exclusivement sécuritaire ne suffira pas à prévenir de nouvelles crises. Un durcissement des contrôles pourrait simplement déplacer les routes migratoires vers des itinéraires plus dispersés et plus dangereux. Elle plaide ainsi pour une approche globale combinant dispositifs de sécurité, opérations de sauvetage et d’accueil, enquête transparente sur les défaillances constatées dans le contrôle des frontières, ainsi que mécanismes plus rapides de lutte contre la désinformation circulant sur les réseaux sociaux locaux. Myriam Cherti appelle également les grandes plateformes numériques à davantage de transparence sur le fonctionnement de leurs algorithmes et sur la manière dont ceux-ci favorisent la diffusion de contenus liés aux migrations à haut risque. En définitive, la chercheuse considère que la crise de Sebta dépasse le cadre d’une simple mobilisation migratoire relayée en ligne. Elle y voit une forme d’« action collective rendue possible par le numérique », où la migration devient à la fois un vecteur d’espoir, une manifestation d’insatisfaction sociale et une expression du malaise politique. Selon elle, ni l’hypothèse d’une manipulation centralisée ni celle de migrants réduits au rôle de victimes passives ne permettent de saisir pleinement la complexité du phénomène. Le véritable défi réside désormais dans la capacité des mobilisations migratoires à s’organiser rapidement et à grande échelle grâce aux outils numériques. The post Etude : Comment Facebook et TikTok ont amplifié la vague de passages vers Sebta appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: Cop martyred, another injured in terrorist attack on police post in Bajaur
items.description: BAJAUR: One cop was martyred while another was wounded after terrorists attacked a police post in Bajaur district’s Barang tehsil in the early hours of Friday. Mansoor Khan, the district police spokesperson, told Dawn that a group of terrorists targeted the police post in Kohi Sar area with rocket launchers and small weapons. He said that police personnel at the post immediately responded and retaliated. The official said two police personnel were wounded in the exchange of fire, which continued for several hours. One of the wounded policemen, identified as Constable Zahir Shah, succumbed to his injuries while being transported to a local hospital for treatment, he said. The other officer, Head Constable Amir Zada, was reported to be out of danger, he added. “The police personnel at the post bravely retaliated and successfully foiled the terrorists’ nefarious design,” the spokesperson added. The funeral prayers of the martyred police official were held at Police Lines in Khar, which was attended by Deputy Commissioner Adnan Farid, District Police Officer (DPO) Khan Zeb Momand and other officials. Earlier this month, at least 14 people, including police officials, were martyred and at least 18 others injured in a suicide attack on Swat’s Kabal police station. On July 30, a terrorist attack on a police checkpost in Hangu martyred nine policemen. KP has seen an uptick in terrorist activity. According to the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies’s monthly security assessment, KP, excluding the merged districts, recorded 154 terrorism related deaths in July, compared with 75 in June, representing an increase of 105 per cent.

items.title: Cisjordanie occupée : que fait l’armée israélienne face au blocus de maisons palestiniennes?
items.description: Des familles palestiniennes sont assiégées depuis plusieurs jours dans le village de Qusra, au nord de la Cisjordanie occupée, où des colons bloquent l’accès à leurs maisons en lançant pierres et menaces. Si l’armée israélienne a démantelé l’avant-poste illégal installé devant les habitations, elle n’a pas, dans un premier temps, délogé les colons, laissant les familles seules face aux attaques. Concrètement, quelles mesures sont prises pour mettre fin à cette situation ? Dans un message sur les réseaux sociaux, l’ambassadeur américain en Israël, Mike Huckabee, pourtant habituellement favorable à la colonisation, a qualifié ce siège d’« acte de terreur » et les colons israéliens de « terroristes ». Comment expliquer ce revirement ?

items.title: 2027: APC youths demand more recognition, vow 10m votes
items.description: By Omeiza Ajayi ABUJA: Youths of the ruling All Progressives Congress APC, have called on President Bola Tinubu and APC governors to embrace inclusivity in governance and accord them more recognition, while pledging to deliver 10 million votes for the president’s 2027 second-term ambition. Speaking under the aegis of Youths on Ground Progressive and Mentorship Initiative YOG, National Coordinator of the group Dr Obioma Nwuba, said they are founded against the pattern of youths being summoned into politics only as thugs or ballot-box protectors, only to be discarded after elections, stressing that his organisation was instead building a disciplined structure of purposeful leadership in which young Nigerians are trained, organised and positioned as genuine stakeholders in governance. Nwuba then turned to his call on the federal government and APC governors, insisting that hope cannot be renewed from Abuja alone but must be delivered in Abuja, Awka and Owo, and felt on the farm in Jalingo and the workshop in Benin. He urged the federal government and APC governors to recognise, endorse and partner with YOG as the grassroots delivery arm of the Renewed Hope Agenda, telling the president directly, “Mr President, you have given us the vision. Give us the vehicle. YOG is that vehicle, tested, structured, and already on the ground.” He told the governors that the group was not asking for handouts but offering foot soldiers for food security, peace and jobs in their states, urging them to integrate YOG into their job and agriculture schemes without delay. “The time for youth conferences is over. The time for youth contracts is now,” he said, adding that every youth left idle is a risk while every youth trained is an asset. He said the group’s Agro-Tech and skills acquisition programmes should be integrated with federal and state job-creation and food-security schemes, and that its mobilisation structures be engaged as the legitimate, organised channel through which government policy reaches the grassroots, describing the arrangement as a necessity rather than a favour. According to him, YOG was formally established in August 2025 as a purpose-driven vehicle for youth mobilisation, mentorship and grassroots empowerment across the country, anchored on the conviction that Nigeria’s youths, who make up over 70 per cent of the population under the age of thirty, must move from the margins of governance to the centre of nation-building. He recalled that the group announced itself on the national stage on 22nd November 2025 at the South-East Youth Summit held at the Oakland Centre, Enugu State, which he called a declaration that Nigerian youths are ready to be organised, mentored and counted as partners rather than spectators in the Renewed Hope project. Nwuba listed the four strategic pillars of the initiative as youth participation in governance and civic engagement, policy advocacy, community-centred peacebuilding, and economic empowerment. According to him, YOG exists to complement and amplify Tinubu’s commitment to youth empowerment, economic revitalisation and national stability, aligning its grassroots activities directly with the president’s Eight-Point Agenda. He said where the Renewed Hope Agenda speaks of food security, the group is already on the farms training young agropreneurs, and where it speaks of job creation, it is already building mentorship pipelines, adding that government policy succeeds or fails at the point of delivery, which he identified as the community. Highlighting the group’s activities within its first year of existence, Nwuba listed the South-East Youth Summit in Enugu on 22nd November 2025, an Agro-Tech Training, Mentorship and Empowerment Programme in Jalingo, Taraba State, on 18th February 2026, and a free malaria and typhoid fever eradication programme in the Federal Capital Territory FCT on 13th March 2026 that reached over 500 beneficiaries. He also cited a similar Agro-Tech programme held in Minna, Niger State, on 2nd May 2026, a malaria and typhoid eradication exercise scheduled for Anambra State on 24th and 25th August 2026, and an Agro-Tech programme for the entire Northwest zone billed for Kaduna State on 5th September 2026. Speaking on Nigeria’s youth demography, Nwuba described the country’s youth population, with a median age below eighteen years, as either the nation’s greatest asset or its greatest risk. He said ten million positive-minded youths, united by structure, mentorship and shared purpose, represent a force capable of stabilising Nigeria’s democracy and driving economic revival, noting that the group is deliberately building across all six geopolitical zones because a young Igbo agropreneur, a young Tarok mentee, and a young beneficiary from Kano are, in the eyes of YOG, simply young Nigerians. The post 2027: APC youths demand more recognition, vow 10m votes appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: El fuego en Niebla (Huelva) continúa fuera de control tras arrasar más de 31.000 hectáreas
items.description: Más de 500 efectivos entre equipos de bomberos forestales de la Junta de Andalucía, la Unidad Militar de Emergencias (UME), militares del Ejército de Tierra y brigadas de refuerzo en incendios forestales (BRIF) se han afanado durante la noche para hacer frente al incendio iniciado hace ya una semana en Niebla (Huelva) y que sigue sin control tras arrasar más de 31.000 hectáreas. La dirección de la emergencia del Plan Infoca mantiene a 658 personas en alejamiento preventivo de diferentes núcleos y diseminados de Niebla, Villarrasa, Berrocal, Zalamea la Real, Paterna del Campo, La Palma del Condado, Escacena del Campo, El Madroño y Aznalcóllar.
